title: 数据增强 (翻转/色彩/裁切)

standard.summary: 训练时对图片施加随机变换：flip_aug 水平翻转，color_aug 随机色彩抖动，random_crop 随机裁切。增加数据多样性，减少过拟合。
standard.effect: flip_aug 将数据量有效翻倍（每张图有原图和镜像两个版本）。color_aug 增加色彩泛化。random_crop 增加构图多样性。
standard.whenToUse: 数据量少（<100 张）时强烈推荐 flip_aug。数据量充足时可选。
standard.avoidWhen: 左右不对称的概念（如文字、特定手势、左右手特征）不要用 flip_aug。color_aug 在写实风格训练中可能引入不自然的色彩。

standard_en.summary: Applies random transforms to the images during training: flip_aug flips horizontally, color_aug jitters colour randomly, random_crop crops randomly. They add variety and reduce overfitting.
standard_en.effect: flip_aug effectively doubles the data (each image in original and mirrored form). color_aug broadens colour generalisation. random_crop varies composition.
standard_en.whenToUse: flip_aug is strongly recommended with little data (<100 images), and optional once there is plenty.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not use flip_aug on concepts that are not left-right symmetric (text, specific gestures, left/right hand features). color_aug can introduce unnatural colour in photorealistic training.

advanced.principle: flip_aug: 50% 概率水平翻转图像（和对应的 loss mask）。color_aug: 随机调整亮度、对比度、饱和度（±10-20%）。random_crop: 在 bucket resize 后进行随机偏移裁切而非中心裁切。albumentations_enabled 提供更强大的增强管线（GaussianBlur、ElasticTransform 等）。
advanced.intervention: DataLoader __getitem__ 时在 PIL image 上施加 torchvision transforms。
advanced.expectedImpact: flip_aug 在 < 50 张数据时可减少 10-20% 过拟合。color_aug 对风格学习帮助大。
advanced.tradeoffs: albumentations_mask_replay 确保同一张图的 mask 和 image 受到相同的空间变换。

advanced_en.principle: flip_aug: 50% chance of horizontal flip (and the corresponding loss mask). color_aug: random brightness/contrast/saturation adjustment (±10-20%). random_crop: after bucket resize, random-offset cropping instead of center cropping. albumentations_enabled provides a more powerful pipeline (GaussianBlur, ElasticTransform, etc.).
advanced_en.intervention: Applies torchvision transforms to the PIL image at DataLoader __getitem__ time.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: With < 50 images, flip_aug reduces overfitting by 10-20%. color_aug helps style learning a lot.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: albumentations_mask_replay ensures the same image's mask and image receive identical spatial transforms.
